_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Xonotic egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Xonotic
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Xonotic, the fast open-source arena shooter. Its settings are in .xonotic/data/server.cfg.
startup: r=; command -v box64 >/dev/null && r=box64; exec $r ./xonotic-linux64-dedicated +set net_address 0.0.0.0 +port {{SERVER_PORT}} +maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Xonotic: downloads a release from dl.xonotic.org, checks it against the
# published checksum, and keeps only what the server needs (the game data
# and the dedicated server). server.cfg and everything else the server
# writes are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

base=https://dl.xonotic.org
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

index=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$base/") || fail "dl.xonotic.org can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
releases=$(grep -oE 'xonotic-[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.zip"' <<<"$index" | sed -E 's/^xonotic-//; s/\.zip"$//' | sort -uV)
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    version=$(tail -n1 <<<"$releases")
else
    grep -qxF "$want" <<<"$releases" || fail "Xonotic has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(tail -n1 <<<"$releases")."
    version=$want
fi
file="xonotic-$version.zip"

if [ -f xonotic-linux64-dedicated ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Xonotic $version is already installed."
else
    mkdir -p "$build/x"
    echo "Downloading Xonotic $version (about 1.2 GB)"
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$build/$file" "$base/$file" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    checked=
    for algo in sha512 sha256 md5; do
        if sums=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$base/xonotic-$version.$algo" 2>/dev/null); then
            sum=$(awk -v f="$file" '$2 == f || $2 == "*"f { print $1 }' <<<"$sums")
            if [ -n "$sum" ]; then
                [ "$("${algo}sum" "$build/$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "The download didn't match Xonotic's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
                checked=1
                break
            fi
        fi
    done
    [ -n "$checked" ] || echo "Xonotic publishes no checksum for $version, so the download wasn't checked."
    unzip -q "$build/$file" 'Xonotic/data/*' 'Xonotic/key_0.d0pk' 'Xonotic/xonotic-linux64-dedicated' 'Xonotic/server/server.cfg' -d "$build/x"
    rm -f "$build/$file"
    # Files the last version had and this one doesn't (its game data) are
    # removed; nothing else is.
    (cd "$build/x/Xonotic" && find . -type f | sort) > "$build/files"
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        comm -23 <(sort .raptor-files) "$build/files" | while read -r f; do rm -f -- "$f"; done
    fi
    cp -a "$build/x/Xonotic/." .
    mv -f "$build/files" .raptor-files
    chmod +x xonotic-linux64-dedicated
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

# The server reads its settings from .xonotic/data/server.cfg.
mkdir -p .xonotic/data
[ -f .xonotic/data/server.cfg ] || cp server/server.cfg .xonotic/data/server.cfg
echo "Installed Xonotic $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Xonotic release, such as 0.8.6, or latest for the newest one. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be on the server, spectators included.
